Remark
[Jet dependence of induced curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0121 ↗ def:pet-ch3-curvature-tensor

1. ch3:3.4.1Let $M$ be an $n$-dimensional submanifold of $\mathbb R^{n+m}$ with the induced metric, given locally by a parametrization $u^s(x^1,\dots ,x^n)$, $s=1,\dots ,n+m$. Show that in these coordinates $R^l_{ijk}$ depends only on the first and second partials of $u^s$.
